blind.description: A stylized, tiered rock formation featuring stacked, chiseled stone faces with warm brown and tan hand-painted textures. Multiple horizontal shelves and the top flat plateau are carpeted with patches of vibrant green moss or grass. The geometry is solid and continuous, forming a cohesive natural environment prop without floating fragments or melting.
blind.from_above: An irregular rounded cluster of stepped rocky terraces, centered around a prominent green mossy plateau with smaller green-topped stone ledges branching off.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 to 4 feet tall (roughly two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 5 to 6 feet wide.
